glosses: Having deteriorated, degraded or fallen from normal, coherent, balanced and desirable to undesirable and typically abnormal.
Having lost good or desirable qualities; hence also having bad character or habits, base, immoral, corrupt.

examples.text: faint-hearted and degenerate king

Againſt a World, a baſe degenerate World,

glosses: Having lost functionality in general.

examples.text: It is likely that the long evolutionary trajectory of Mycoplasma went from a reductive autotroph to oxidative heterotroph to a cell-wall–defective degenerate parasite. glosses: Having multiple domain elements correspond to one element of the range.

examples.text: The genetic code is degenerate because a single amino acid can be coded by one of several codons.

glosses: Qualitatively different, usually simpler, than typical objects of its class.

examples.text: A degenerate circle, having radius zero, consists of a single point.
